shots.title: Hero, studio

shots.prompt: Studio automotive photograph of a boxy electric SUV of original design with flush glass, a light-bar face and all-terrain tyres, finished in matte sand-white paint, three-quarter front view in a vast dark studio. One long overhead softbox draws a continuous highlight along the bonnet, shoulder line and roof; polished dark concrete floor with a soft reflection under the car; negative space on the left for a headline. Original vehicle design, unbadged. Overall look: clean daylight product photography, crisp and airy; colour palette of sand white, sage, charcoal, sky blue. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
